plugins.name: release-guard
plugins.description: Catch the ways a desktop release ships broken while every job exits zero: duplicate draft releases, colliding update manifests, a staged rollout that never rotates its cohort, certificate renewal drift under the 460 day cap, and an updater that fails open on signature verification.

plugins.name: repo-compliance
plugins.description: The checks that must pass before a repo goes public, and the ones a linter will not do for you: licence and third-party notices, WCAG AA contrast verified by math, and honesty in every published claim.
